# Original shared-schema references

Fixed SiYuan KeyValues/view columns and fixed AppFlowy-Collab create_field/get_fields_in_view/FieldSettings sources, with original licenses. AppFlowy originals are reconstructed by reversing the recorded runtime patch and matching the fixed upstream file hashes. These are review references, not a new kernel. Runtime uses the existing original FieldMap/type codecs and a pure view projection adapter; no new schema protocol or read-time CRDT repair.
